adjudication.rationale: In `packages/core/EventManager.ts` `createAllCalendarEvents`, when iterating `for (const destination of event.destinationCalendar)`, the `else` branch for `!destination.credentialId` filters `this.calendarCredentials` by `c.type === destination.integration` and then does `Promise.all(...map(createEvent(c, event)))`. This ignores the specific `destination.externalId` and will create events for *every* credential of that integration type held by the EventManager (potentially multiple organizer creds), producing duplicates and not targeting the intended destination calendar when it can't be linked to a credential.
